"""Reconstruct actual FP32 weighted objectives and common-loss routing from the trace."""
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import yaml
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard,read,ref,save
from train_v43_quality_trial import live


def reconstruct(components,recipe,arm,domain,ADC):
 f=np.float32;weight=f(recipe['domain_loss_weights'][domain])
 value=f(f(f(components['pixel'])+f(f(recipe['gradient_weight'])*f(components['gradient'])))+f(f(recipe['spectral_weight'])*f(components['spectral'])))
 value=f(weight*value)
 for coefficient,field,paired in [('local_risk_weight','local_excess_risk',False),('regional_DC_weight','regional_DC_excess',False),
  ('paired_response_weight','paired_response',True),('flat_anchor_weight','flat_target_anchor',False),('pair_common_weight','pair_common_error',True)]:
  if arm[coefficient] and (not paired or components['coupled_pairs']):
   value=f(value+f(f(weight*f(arm[coefficient]))*f(components[field])))
 if ADC and arm['ADC_loss_weight']==0:value=f(value*0)
 return value


def main():
 repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v2';plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
 status=read(root/'status-v1.json');assert status['status']=='completed-matched-training-awaiting-fixed-quality-review' and not live(status['owner'])
 config=yaml.safe_load(Path(plan['config']['path']).read_text());training=read(root/'train-result-v1.json');cache=read(plan['cache']['path'])
 assert len(training['trace'])==len(cache['batches'])==1000
 rows=[];groups=defaultdict(list);maximum=0.
 for row,batch in zip(training['trace'],cache['batches'],strict=True):
  assert row['step']==batch['step'] and row['batch']==batch['arrays'];domain=row['domain']
  ADC=batch['metadata']['noise']['shot']==batch['metadata']['noise']['read']==0
  paired=batch['inputs']['pair_indices']['shape'][0]
  for name,arm in config['arms'].items():
   c=row['arms'][name];actual=reconstruct(c,config,arm,domain,ADC)
   assert actual.tobytes()==np.float32(c['loss']).tobytes(),(row['step'],name,float(actual),c['loss'])
   assert c['coupled_pairs']==paired
   if not paired:assert c['pair_common_error']==0
   else:assert np.isfinite(c['pair_common_error']) and c['pair_common_error']>=0
   assert c['common_support_detached']==bool(arm['common_detach_support'] and paired)
   assert 0<=c['support_mean']<=1 and np.isfinite(c['spectral_delta_RMS']) and c['spectral_delta_RMS']>=0
   assert c['declared_support_floor']==arm['support_floor']
   assert arm['support_floor']<=c['support_minimum']<=c['support_maximum']<=1
   if ADC:assert actual==c['gradient_norm']==0
   records={'step':row['step'],'arm':name,'domain':domain,'ADC_only':ADC,'pairs':paired,
    'actual_loss':c['loss'],'independent_FP32_loss':float(actual),'common_error':c['pair_common_error'],'common_support_detached':c['common_support_detached'],
    'common_term_has_nonzero_total_weight':bool(arm['pair_common_weight'] and paired and not ADC)}
   rows.append(records);groups[name,domain,ADC].append(records)
 summary=[{'arm':arm,'domain':domain,'ADC_only':ADC,'batches':len(items),'pairs':sum(v['pairs'] for v in items),
  'fixed_support_batches':sum(v['common_support_detached'] for v in items),
  'common_supervised_batches':sum(v['common_term_has_nonzero_total_weight'] for v in items),
  'mean_recorded_common_loss':float(np.mean([v['common_error'] for v in items]))} for (arm,domain,ADC),items in groups.items()]
 output=root/'training-objective-audit-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
 save(output,{'status':'pass-all2000-FP32-objective-reconstructions-and-common-routing','training':ref(root/'train-result-v1.json'),'config':plan['config'],
  'cache':plan['cache'],'weighted_total_losses_checked':2000,'bit_exact_total_losses':True,'rows':rows,'groups':summary,
  'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,
  'scope':'Two identical V167 bounded-support heads,124909 parameters/47 tensors,support floor.25,all90 neural source files unchanged. Only candidate data distribution differs:171/341 mesh batches replace periods6..32 with6..10 and balanced contrast bands.02,.05,.125,.25,.4;829 original batches/parents unchanged. Camera/CFA/geometry/background/exposure/noise coefficients/seeds match;changed Poisson rates do not imply identical noisy draws. New clean empty targets exactly match legacy. Same V167 common fixed-support surrogate routing/weight1/unit16,difference1/floor2/epsilon.003,anchor.25,base losses/init/AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA. 1000updates each,fixed raw/EMA endpoints/all822 cases,3288 review roots/1644 new external arrays and1644 actual bit-exact V167 control replays. No architecture,loss or held-out input changes;frequency and contrast change jointly,not isolated factors. New data cache has171 original parent/DINO roots plus171 explicit archived-deterministic-policy validation roots;684images each pass,342root/1368images total per parent/backbone. All inputs/noise constructed once;6 inspected inputs adopted and165additional inputs. Head stages have20 discarded smoke+2000 train+3288 review=5308roots/11368images,with no new compatibility roots becauseall90 neural sources match. 288 CPU checks;genuine8+2 restoration;94 final Adam states;all1000 V167 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam and1644 actual outputs must reproduce. Actual units and masks need audits for171 new target batches;829 inherited masks replay separately. Both GFX scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs and18held-out IDs stay excluded;references qualitative,notGT.72native figures/24triplets/actual viewing/eight retained comparators. New56/116GiB reserves+.5GiB margin,.25GiB local bound;12GiB CUDA,52/32GiB RAM. Originals/dataz unused;prior sources,receipts,first data-cache flag omission and all predictions preserved. No quality or flat-safety guarantee.'})
 print('PASS2000 bit-exact actual FP32 weighted loss reconstructions and all common-loss routing')

if __name__=='__main__':main()
